node.statement: Proposition 2.4 (Partial trace with SWAP): Let M = M_{AB} act on C^d tensor C^r. Then tr_A(SWAP_{AC}(M_{AB} tensor I_C)) = M_{CB} = tr_A((M_{AB} tensor I_C) SWAP_{AC}). This is a standard identity for partial traces involving SWAP operators, verified by direct computation in the computational basis.
